verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain explicitly implements reachability analysis, flagging findings as reachable when a matching code pattern exists in the codebase, which directly supports prioritizing dependency alerts by reachability. However, evidence lacks detail on how reachability is surfaced in triage workflows (e.g., filtering/sorting UI, PR gating specifically by reachability) and no independent/hands-on verification of reachability accuracy is present. missing for 10: evidence of UI/workflow for filtering or sorting alerts by reachability status, independent validation of reachability detection accuracy, detail on false negative/positive rates for reachability analysis.
